philadelphia.name: Sunday Breakfast Rescue Mission
philadelphia.description: Philadelphia's largest homeless shelter for men. Houses 220 men each night with dinner served 5-6pm daily.

philadelphia.name: Project HOME — Outreach Coordination Center
philadelphia.description: 24/7 homeless outreach hotline and street outreach coordination. Permanent supportive housing, medical care, and education programs.
philadelphia.hours: Outreach hotline 24/7; Office Mon-Fri 9:00 AM - 4:00 PM

philadelphia.name: Bethesda Project — Our Brothers' Place
philadelphia.description: Emergency shelter for 149 men with warm meals, case management, and social services.

philadelphia.name: St. John's Hospice — Day Services
philadelphia.description: Free showers with clean clothing. Hot noon meals for men. On-site nursing, case management, and mail services.
philadelphia.hours: Mon-Fri 9:00 AM - 5:00 PM; Showers Mon/Tue/Wed/Fri 8:30-9:15 AM

philadelphia.name: Broad Street Love
philadelphia.description: Free clothing closet, personal care items, hygiene products, mail service, meals, case management, and legal aid.

philadelphia.name: The Wardrobe Philadelphia
philadelphia.description: Free clothing for job seekers and daily needs. Professional, casual, and formal wear. Walk-in shopping welcome.

miami.name: Camillus House
miami.description: Full-service center for homeless men, women, and children. Emergency shelter, hot meals, showers, clothing, health care, and job placement.
miami.hours: Mon-Fri 8:00am-5:00pm; Shelter intake via Homeless Helpline 1-877-994-4357

miami.name: Chapman Partnership Homeless Assistance Center
miami.description: 500-bed homeless assistance center with meals, case management, on-site medical clinic, child care, and job training.

miami.name: Camillus House Day Center — Hygiene Services
miami.description: Free showers, hygiene kits, restrooms, towels, soap, shampoo, and personal care items. Mail and phone access available.
